hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.css|*.json|*.jsonc) (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && pnpm exec biome check --write "$f") ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && out=$(pnpm typecheck 2>&1) || jq -n --arg o "$out" '{systemMessage: ("Typecheck failed:\n" + $o)}'
